readyGenericMode.name: Legacy +4/+5 band estimate
readyGenericMode.formula: u=round(underbustIn); b=u+(u%2==0?4:5); d=round(bustIn)-b. Cup difference1=A,2=B. Extend the cup ladder only under an explicitly declared size convention.
readyGenericMode.rounding: For positive half-inch ties, round up; that tie convention is an implementation choice. Round measurements separately before subtracting.
readyGenericMode.limits: An alternative traditional fitting convention; not universal or guaranteed fit. Negative difference is unsupported, never silently clamp to AA. Preserve direct-band estimate as a separate named method.

importantSourceDisagreement.finding: NHS Frimley uses the same +4/+5 band arithmetic but labels its example 29-inch underbust/36-inch bust as 34C (difference2), while Triumph uses difference2=B. Do not merge their cup conventions into one attributed system.

namedChartCandidate.name: Freya international size guide, retrieved 2026-10-09
namedChartCandidate.dataUseStatus: Research reference only; permission/reuse basis unresolved. Do not silently bundle as a licensed manufacturer chart.
namedChartCandidate.rightsFinding: Sections2.1/2.2 restrict automated extraction and nonpersonal content reuse without express consent. No open data licence was found. This records source terms, not a legal conclusion about factual size relationships.
namedChartCandidate.lookup: Band and cup rows share independent positions within each array; never convert an arbitrary letter through ASCII arithmetic or label all brands equivalent.
namedChartCandidate.domain: UK/US bands28..44 step2; supported cups startB. A/AA and bands outside the table must return unavailable, not extrapolate.

safeUserInputAlternative: Allow user-entered band and cup mapping rows, show the source name/date, and return exact chart matches. No regional conversion exists until a row is entered. Link the manufacturer guide for fit confirmation. This does not establish full built-in chart parity.

implementationUpdate.note: Earlier research retained as historical evidence. Use the linked update and remaining-mode audit for current implementation and limits.
